meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 当你让它执行计划时,Claude 不再自己动手,而是当总指挥,派出多个小助手分别负责实现、验证、检查代码质量和提交;每个阶段验证通过后才进入下一步并提交代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行、运行或落实某个计划时触发,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 请执行我们刚才定的实施方案。
say.note: Claude 会派出小助手分工实施并验证。

say.text: 运行 make-plan 生成的计划,一步一步来。
say.note: 每阶段验证通过后才会继续下一步。

say.text: 执行这个计划,验证通过后再提交代码。
say.note: 未通过验证时不会提交代码。

howto.what_en: When asked to execute a plan, Claude acts as an orchestrator instead of doing the work itself: it dispatches subagents for implementation, verification, code-quality review, and commit, and only commits after verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Please execute the implementation plan we just defined.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches subagents to implement and verify.

say_en.text: Run the plan generated by make-plan, step by step.
say_en.note: Each phase must pass verification before moving on.

say_en.text: Execute this plan and commit only after verification passes.
